English: TYNWALD
ST JOHN’S 5th July, 1938.
ABSTRACTS
OF
ACTS FOR PROMULGATION
Printed (By Authority) by I.O.M. Examiner Ltd, Hill Street, Douglas
1.— The Actions of Arrest Act, 1937.
Manx: 1.— Slattys Aggyrtsyn Goaill-Seose, Nuy cheead shiaght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this act is to amend the law as to the arrest of debtors.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy lhiasaghey yn leigh bentyn da goaill seose jatteryn.

English: 2.— The Gibson Divorce Act, 1937.
Manx: 2.— Slattys Scarree Gibson, Nuy cheead shiaght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this act is to dissolve the marriage of J. A. Gibson and wife.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy chur ass bree poosey J. A. Gibson as e ven.

English: 3.— The Leonard Divorce Act, 1937.
Manx: 3.— Slattys Scarree Leonard, Nuy cheead shiaght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this act is to dissolve the marriage of T. J. Leonard and wife.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy chur ass bree poosey T. J. Leonard as e ven.

English: 4.— The Maynord Divorce Act, 1937.
Manx: 4.— Slattys Scarree Maynard, Nuy cheead shiaght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this act is to dissolve the marriage of J. Maynard and wife.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy chur ass bree poosey J. Maynard as e ven.

English: 5.— The National Health Insurance Act, 1937.
Manx: 5.‚— Yn Slattys Urrys Slaynt Ashoonagh, Nuy keead jeig, shiaght jeig as feed..

English: The object and purport of this act is to maintain the rate of sickness benefit for women.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy chummal seose feeuid yn oays ching cour mraane.

English: 6.— The Water Companies’ Regulation Ammendment Act, 1938.
Manx: 6.— Slattys Lhiasee Reill Sheshaghtyn Ushtey, Nuy cheead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this act is to amend the Water Companies’ Acts as to taking samples of water..
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy lhiasaghey Slattysyn Sheshaghtyn Ushtey bentyn da goaill sambylyn dy ushtey.

English: 7.—  The Water (Supply) Amendment Act, 1938.
Manx: 7.— Slattys Lhiasee Kiarail Ushtey, Doghanyn Ollee (Lhiettalys), Nuy cheead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this act is to enlarge the area of the Northern Water Board to include the parish of Maughold.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy vooadaghey magh yn Voayrd Ushtey Hwoaie dy ghoaill stiagh Skyll Maghal.

English: 8.— The Workmen’s Compensation Act, 1938.
Manx: 8.— Slattys Aayeeilley Obbreeyn, Nuy cheead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this act is to amend the Workmen’s Compensation Act, 1937.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy lhiasaghey Slattys Aayeeilley Obbreeyn.

English: 9.— The Superannuation Act, 1938.
Manx: 9.— Slattys Harrish-Eash, Nuy cheead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to provide for superannuation of persons transferring between the Civil Service, Boards of Tynwald, and local authorities.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy chiarail son harrish-eash persoonyn scughey eddyr yn Chirveish Chaayragh, Buird Whaiyl Keeil Eoin as Reiltys Vannin.

English: 10.— The Highway Act, 1938.
Manx: 10.— Slattys ny Raaidyn Mooarey, Nuy cheead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this act is to exempt from licence duty dogs kept for agricultura purposes.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy heyrey voish eeck taill kied moddee cummit cour oyryn eirinagh.

English: 11.— The Agricultural Rates and Improvements Fund Amendment Act, 1938.
Manx: 11. Slattys Lhiasee Keeshyn Eirinagh as Kishtey Lhiasaghyn, Nuy cheead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to empower life tennants to receive loans from the Agricultural Improvements Fund.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy chur pooar da yannysyn bea dy gheddyn eeasaghtyn voish Kishtey Lhiasaghyn Eirinagh.

English: 12.— The School Teachers’ (Superannuation) Act, 1938.
Manx: 12.— Slattys (Harrish-Eash) Lught-ynsee Schoillyn, Nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to amend the School Teachers (superannuation) Acts.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy lhiasaghey Slattysyn (Harrish-Eash) Lught Ynsee Schoillyn.

English: 13.— The National Health Insurance (Juvenile Contributors and Young Persons)  Act, 1938.
Manx: 13.— Slattys Urrys Slaynt Ashoonagh (Cohoyrtysee Aegey), Nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to provide insurance for medical benefit of employed persons under sixteen.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy chiarail urrys cour foays lheihyssagh persoonyn failt aegey fo shey-jeig.

English: 14.— The Local Government (Open Spaces) Act, 1938.
Manx: 14. Slattys Kiannoortys Ynnydagh (Spoaraghyn Foshlit), Nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to empower local authorities to acquire land for open spaces.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy phooaraghey reiltysyn ynnydagh dy gheddyn thalloo cour spoaraghyn foshlit.

English: 15.— The Counterfeit Currency (Convention) Act, 1938.
Manx: 15.— Slattys Argid-cadjin Foalsey (Cohionnal), Nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to give effect to an International Convention for the suppression of counterfeiting currency.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy chur bree da Cohionnal Eddyr-ashoonagh dy vooghey jannoo Argid-cadjin Foalsey.

English: 16. The Infanticide and Infant Life (Preservation) Act, 1938.
Manx: 16. Slattys Freayltys Bioys Oikanagh as Oikan-Marroodys, Nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to amend the law with regard to the destruction of children at or before birth.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy lhiasaghey yn leigh bentyn da stoialtys lhiennee ec ny roish ruggyr.

English: 17. The Education Act, 1938.
Manx: 17. Slattys Ynsee, Nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to raise the school leaving age and amend the Education Acts.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy hroggal yn eash son faagail schoill as lhiasaghey Slattysyn Ynsee.

English: 18. The Trustee Act, 1938.
Manx: 18. Slattys ny Treishteilee, Nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to amend the Trustee Acts as to the investment of trust money..
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy lhiasaghey ny Treishteilee bentyn da cur er eeasagh arigidyn treishtagh.

English: 19. The Law Reform (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act, 1938.
Manx: 19. Slattys Aachummey yn Leigh (Caghlaaghyn dy Chiarailyn), Nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to amend the law as to the effect of death in relation to causes of action and as to interest on judgement debts.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy lhiasaghey yn leigh bentyn da eiyrtys baaish ayns cochiangley rish oyryn aggyrtys as bentyn da use er feeaghyn briwnyssagh.

English: 20. The Cattle Breeding Amendment Act, 1938.
Manx: 20. Slattys Lhiasee Breh Ollee, Nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to amend the Cattle Breeding Act, 1922.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy lhiasaghey Slattys Breh Ollee, Nuy keead jeig jees as feed.

English: 21. The Horse Breeding Amendment Act, 1938.
Manx: 21. Slattys Lhiasee Breh Cabbil, Nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to amend the Horse Breeding Act, 1921.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy lhiasaghey Slattys Breh Cabbil, Nuy keead jeig nane as feed.

English: 22. The Douglas Library Act, 1938.
Manx: 22. Slattys Lioar-hasht Ghoolish, Nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to raise the limit for library purposes in Douglas.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy hroggal yn cheesh chaglit cour kiarailyn lioar-hasht ayns Doolish.

English: 23. The Rates Act, 1938.
Manx: 23. Slattys ny Keeshyn, nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to amend the law relating to certain rates.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy lhiasaghey yn leigh bentyn da shiartanse dy cheeshyn baljagh.

English: 24. The Douglas Squares Act, 1938.
Manx: 24. Slattys Kerrinyn Doolish, nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to vest Hutchinson Square and Woodbourne Square in the Corporation of Douglas.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy chur Kerrin Hutchinson as Kerrin Woodbourne fo reirey Chochorp Ghoolish.

English: 25. The Highway Amendment Act, 1938.
Manx: 25. Slattys Lhiasee ny Raaidyn Mooarey, nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to amend duties payable on motor vehicles under the Highway Act.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy lhiasaghey ny taillyn ry eeckit er fainee votor fo Slattys ny Raaidyn Mooarey.

English: 26. The Trustees Amendment (No. 2) Act, 1938.
Manx: 26. Slattys ny Treishteilee (Earroo jees), nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to amend the Trustee Act, 1937.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy lhiasaghey Slattys ny Treishteilee, nuy keead jeig as feed.

English: 27. The Rent (Restrictions) Act, 1938.
Manx: 27. Slattys Mayll (Teoraghyn), nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: The object and purport of this Act is to extend and amend the Rent Restriction Act.
Manx: Ta nhee as bree yn Clattys shoh dy heeyney as lhiasaghey Slattysyn Teoraghyn Mayll.

English: The ROYAL ASSENT to the foregoing Acts was given on the dates set out hereunder:—
Manx: Va’n Cordail Reeoil da ny Slattysyn goll roish er ny chur er ny laghyn soit magh fo shoh:—

English: Nos. 1, 2, and 3 at Buckingham Palace ... 1st July, 1937.
Manx: Earrooyn ’nane, jees as tree ec Plaase Buckingham, y Chied laa jeh’n Chiaghtoo vee, Nuy keead shiaght-jeig as feed.

English: Nos. 4 and 5. at Buckingham Palace ... 29th July, 1937.
Manx: Earrooyn kiare as queig ec Plaase Buckingham yn Nuyoo laa as feed jeh’n Chiaghtoo vee, Nuy keead jeig, shiaght-jeig as feed.

English: Nos 6, 7, 8 and 9 at Buckingham Palace ... 24th February, 1938.
Manx: Earrooyn shey, shiaght, hoght as nuy as jeih ec Plaase Buckingham y chiarroo laa as feed jeh’n Nah vee, Nuy keead jeig, hoght-jeig as feed.

English: No. 10 at Buckingham Palace ... 28th  February, 1938.
Manx: Earroo jeih ec Plaase Buckingham yn hoghtoo laa as feed jeh’n Nah vee, Nuy keead jeig, hoght-jeig as feed.

English: Nos 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18 and 19 at Buckingham Palace ... 1st April, 1938.
Manx: Earrooyn tree-jeig, kiare-jeig as queig-jeig ec Plaase Buckingham yn Chied laa jeh’n Chiarroo vee, Nuy keead jeig, hoght-jeig as feed.

English: Nos. 20, 21 and 22 at Buckingham Palace ... 6th May 1938.
Manx: Earrooyn feed, nane as feed, as jees as feed ec Plaase Buckingham yn Cheyoo laa jeh’n Wheiggoo vee, Nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.

English: Nos. 23, 24, 25, 26 and 27, at Buckingham Palace ... 23rd June, 1938.
Manx: Earrooyn tree as feed, kiare as feed, queig as feed, shey as feed as shiaght as feed ec Plaase Buckingham yn treeoo laa as feed jeh’n Cheyoo vee, Nuy keead jeig, hoght jeig as feed.
